articles.title: PEP 848: Generational Incremental Garbage Collection
articles.description: This PEP proposes adding a new cyclic garbage collector to CPython. The new collector will be both generational and incremental. Collections will alternate: a young collection, then an (incremental) old collection, then a young collection, and so on.
